segments.label: eyes_open
segments.instruction: Sit still, face forward, and keep your eyes open without speaking.

segments.label: eyes_closed
segments.instruction: Sit still with eyes gently closed. Do not speak or deliberately move.

segments.label: blink_artifact
segments.instruction: Make deliberate, separated blinks while otherwise remaining still.

segments.label: jaw_artifact
segments.instruction: Make gentle, repeated jaw or facial-muscle movements while keeping your head still.

segments.label: head_motion_artifact
segments.instruction: Make slow, deliberate side-to-side head movements without speaking.

segments.label: listening
segments.instruction: Sit still and listen silently to the selected immutable neutral audio asset.

segments.label: speaking
segments.instruction: Sit still and repeat the pinned neutral count script aloud at a comfortable, even pace.

segments.label: recovery
segments.instruction: Sit still, do not speak, and return to a quiet eyes-open baseline.
